notes: GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM modeled as DeepSeek-V3 MLA plus DSA sparse attention: the lightning indexer (32 heads x 128, top-2048) scores every causal pair and MLA attends to the selected top-2048 keys. BF16 weights as published; the MLA latent cache and the indexer key cache are assumed BF16. The MTP layer is not modeled.
